prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game scene-state plate. Edit this four-cell storm garden into the new austere material design. Keep 2 columns by 2 rows; exact same fixed room geography, camera, three low ceramic brick beds, sink centre-left, left small window, vent, right door, original lamps and clear foreground floor. Four states must share geometry and plants. Warm practical illustrated game art, no text or borders.
Change ALL cells: remove the tall potato collar and every post, finial, buckle, frame, rigid cream rim and wooden trellis. Potato plants stand in the unchanged original low brick bed: thin flexible waterproof liner folded over rim, modest hill WITHIN the old bed rim, plain loose brown opaque surface sheet around stems below leaves. Mature soybeans centre use thin light grey synthetic cargo net tensioned to existing hab fabric-seam tabs with small simple cord ties, no poles or rods. Lettuce right stays. No hardware is added to support soft goods.
Row-major cells: 0 top-left: mature garden with NO wall screen and NO overhead crop canopy. 1 top-right: same garden plus full entrance-wall thermal screen, plain thin crinkled packing foil backed with cloth, tied directly to existing seam tabs. The screen follows the end wall behind the existing sink, covers the window/door wall, preserves sink and vent access and an overlapping door flap. No curtain rail, rings, rods or new wall.
2 bottom-left: no wall screen; a plain beige Fabric crop canopy held ABOVE ALL foliage on a broad taut light grey synthetic cargo net. Its corners are tied directly to existing high wall seam tabs, with clearly visible thin cord tension lines. There is no freestanding canopy frame, pole, ridge beam or rigid rolled front bar. Cloth gently sags over net, with soft side folds toward bed edges and a visible front circulation gap. Show small plain cloth roll-up ties for opening during lamp hours. No extra lights below canopy. This is lowered nighttime cover, with original ceiling lamps only dimly glowing.
3 bottom-right: the same wall screen AND the same overhead net-supported cloth canopy together, with original scene identical.
Canopy must not touch leaves, cover only bed sidewalls, or become furniture. Keep it above plant tops, soft and visibly suspended from habitat tabs. No timber, wicker, leather, brass, buckles, eyelets, decorative trim, new fastener rows, support poles or curtain rings.
